:::{#cor-entropy-chain-rule-reversed}
#### Chain rule for entropy, other order

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$,

$$\entropyf{X, Y} = \entropyf{X \mid Y} + \entropyf{Y}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

The pair $(Y, X)$ takes each value $(y, x)$ with the same [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability)
that $(X, Y)$ takes $(x, y)$,
so

$$\entropyf{Y, X} = \entropyf{X, Y}.$$

The [chain rule](#thm-entropy-chain-rule),
applied with the roles of $X$ and $Y$ exchanged,
gives

$$\entropyf{Y, X} = \entropyf{Y} + \entropyf{X \mid Y}.$$

Combining the two displays gives the claim.

:::
